title: AnalysisItem
description: A single analysis item to be uploaded. Items are grouped by (book, chapter) and submitted to the corresponding scope endpoint.

book.description: 3-letter USFM/U23003 book code (e.g. MAT, GEN, REV). Null or omitted for repo-level items.

chapter.description: Chapter number. Null or omitted for book-level or repo-level items.

anchor.description: U23003 scripture reference string (e.g. 'MAT 2:11', 'MAT 2:1-3'). Null for scope-level items.

type.description: Observation type identifier (e.g. 'question'). Must be registered in the analysis_type registry.

version.description: Version of the observation type schema (e.g. '1.0').

observation.description: Self-describing observation data. Must include 'type' and 'version' fields matching the envelope. Shape defined by the registered analysis_type schema.
